paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.07% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+4.77%) and Dow Jones weakest (-1.18%). Brent crude changed -9.04% to 96.96. Gold changed -2.17% to 4,204.6001. Bitcoin changed -0.18% to 83,882.9688. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.293%, a relative move of +3.50%. Among the firms tracked, Apollo (-6.67%) and Newmont (-6.65%) moved the most.
